video.title: What is Kubernetes Operator and How it works? #kubernetes

transcript.text: What is a Kubernetes operator? So a
Kubernetes operator is an extension of
Kubernetes that lets you manage complex
application in the same way as you
manage pods or deployments. So how it
actually works is you need a custom
resource definition in which you define
your new object which could be a
posgress cluster or a Prometheus
instance. Along with this you also need
a controller that is going to
continuously check this objects to make
sure that it matches the desired state.
For example, you can use Postgress
operator to create and manage Postgress
SQL clusters just by defining Postgress
cluster resource in the CRD. Similarly,
you can also use Prometheus operator to
manage and deploy Prometheus instances
in the cluster and so on. So, an
operator is just a CRD with a
controller. Subscribe.
